title: Vessel O2 x vessel glucose grid, 5 x 5, 24 h at dt 0.005

observables: alive and dead cells and dead fraction at 24 h; living edge (95th percentile of x of the living cells) and proliferative edge (growth rate above half of the maximum); cells per 10 um bin; cap fraction and ledger

rationale: 6 factors multiplied by 0.5-2 (log-uniform), scrambled Sobol seed 1; 16 points are a screening, not variance indices.

title: dt 0.00125 min, 24 h
